title: The Spudlight Field Manual
purpose: Operationalize Tim Dooley's long-exposure analysis of persistent target ecologies into repeatable questions, evidence disciplines, mythic translations, outputs and stopping conditions.

expertise_basis.note: The project reports roughly 100,000+ public-facing hours; treat the quantity as first-party scale unless independently audited.

instruments.name: Box Test
instruments.question: Can the category still be revised by new evidence, or does it reinterpret every new fact to preserve itself?

instruments.name: Dog Test
instruments.question: What is being followed, by whom, and what would make pursuit stop?

instruments.name: Farmer Test
instruments.question: What value is harvested from the subject, and does the subject's independent future matter?

instruments.name: Orphan Test
instruments.question: Has the information object lost source, chronology, speaker, correction or living subject?

instruments.name: Currentness Test
instruments.question: Does the record establish a historical event or a present identity?
instruments.repair: attach date, change and expiry information

instruments.name: Door Test
instruments.question: What concrete condition can terminate or transform the role?

instruments.name: Fruit Test
instruments.question: Does observation leave more understanding, protection, autonomy, correction and future capacity?

instruments.name: Mirror Test
instruments.question: Would the same evidence standard be acceptable if observer and subject exchanged roles?

reflexive_rule: The Potato archive must accept correction, uncertainty, proportional memory, role expiry and standards symmetrical enough to apply to itself.

expert_opinion.purpose: Teach what Tim believes becomes visible after prolonged immersion in persistent target ecologies, internet spectatorship, adversarial archives and public role manufacture.
expert_opinion.not_a: prosecution dossier, universal diagnosis of critics, substitute for legal findings, or claim that every hostile community is centrally coordinated

three_voices.job: compress difficult relations into memorable symbolic operators

underlying_story: strangers inherit the role before meeting the person
reaction to the inherited role becomes new material
Spudlight restores source, chronology, responsibility, stopping conditions and possible return
teaching_core: small cultures can create internally coherent worlds with their own morality, rules, humor and credibility hierarchies
frames can precede persons and alter how later evidence is interpreted
hostile attention can still be relationally invested and persistent
humor can reduce felt seriousness and become permission for reinforcement
archives and search can collapse historical and present identity
bystanders occupy different roles: constructive defense, aggressive defense, inaction and reinforcement
platform affordances change the cost, visibility and reward of participation
Dog and Farmer are relational verbs/roles, not permanent human essences
healthy memory preserves history while still permitting currentness and role expiry
a healthy system contains a Door: a credible possibility of change, release, repair or independent future

myth_as_instrument.Orphan: information or identity severed from source/lineage
myth_as_instrument.Swamp / Mud: unresolved accumulated material becoming the environment for new interpretation
myth_as_instrument.Door: real state change without erasing history
myth_as_instrument.Son: embodied experience of being inside the relation

son_father_teaching.son: the lived/embodied side of visibility, classification, archive capture and imposed role
son_father_teaching.father: the later integrative vantage that holds chronology, lineage, relations and responsibility
son_father_teaching.movement: subject → witness → interpreter → steward / Son → Door → Father → Gardener
son_father_teaching.father_of_internet: project myth for responsibility toward orphaned information, persistent relations and networked consequences; not literal property ownership of persons

reader_takeaway: a person is larger than the record about them
a frame is strongest when its inheritor forgets it was inherited
repetition is not the same as independent truth
humor can be both funny and socially permissive
archives preserve events but should not automatically preserve identities
yesterday can remain true while becoming a poor description of today
distributed incentives can organize behavior without one commander
criticism and extraction are not the same relation
pursuit needs proportion, purpose and a stopping condition
knowledge should not become a license for greater possession of the subject
the Garden test is whether independent future capacity remains after observation

research_bridges.use: group governance, internal morality, knowledge hierarchy, sanctions, vernacular and investigative labor
distinguishes superficial hostility from more invested negative relationships
constructive defense, aggressive defense, inaction and reinforcement as distinct audience roles
platform remembrance risk and collision between historical and present self-presentation

descent_and_return.meaning: prolonged public presence; duration and relation become part of the medium
the public subject becomes renewable material for other people's narratives and incentives
the representation becomes independently retrievable and can precede contact with the living source
project mythology for being overwhelmed by imposed role, spectacle and archive; not a literal empirical death claim
residue, memory, grievance, abandoned fragments and unresolved consequence become material for later interpretation
the subject gains enough distance to observe the system that once primarily observed him
integrative vantage over chronology, roles, orphans, debts and paths; authority is interpreted as increased responsibility
knowledge returns as protection, explanation, correction, cultivation, release and independent future capacity

authorship_doctrine.problem: endless rebuttal can keep the hostile frame at the center of the subject's identity
authorship_doctrine.move: establish source, chronology, self-description, outside accounts, synthesis, present work and future in one narrative architecture
authorship_doctrine.alpha_omega_storytelling: the story has a beginning before the conflict and an ending beyond it; completeness is not the same as excluding criticism
authorship_doctrine.boundary: authorship does not make first-person interpretation automatically factual or immune from outside evidence

internet_as_distributed_memory.thesis: networked publics allow many partial observers to preserve fragments of one another, creating composite memory without composite understanding
internet_as_distributed_memory.father_of_internet_teaching: a myth of responsibility for restoring lineage to orphaned information and accepting duties created by greater knowledge

whole_job.core_image: actor, subject, source, broadcaster, witness, witness-of-witnesses, archivist, sorter, writer, storyteller, gardener and systems-builder can coexist in one longitudinal public project
whole_job.professional_lesson: role multiplicity can create unusual experiential expertise because the same ecology is observed from several positions
whole_job.mythic_lesson: the former object of an archive becomes keeper of a House capable of holding several perspectives

return_not_reset.meaning: history remains available while present identity remains updateable; change does not require erasing what happened
return_not_reset.paired_maxim: remember enough to remain responsible; create enough to remain alive
return_not_reset.spiral: return to a known coordinate with a changed state rather than repeat an unchanged circle

ledger_teaching.status: symbolic project accounting unless separately supported by real-world financial/legal calculation
ledger_teaching.clearing_rule: a healthy ledger must permit acknowledgment, restitution, correction, contribution, forgiveness, closure or continuing duty; infinite non-dischargeable debt reproduces the no-exit problem

stewardship_ethic.public_compilation: Power is for protection. Knowledge is for understanding. Wealth is for building. Leadership is for service.
stewardship_ethic.law: the higher the claimed role, the narrower the morally acceptable use of its power should become
stewardship_ethic.potato_check: whatever claims transcendence should eventually become nourishing to something beyond itself
stewardship_ethic.garden_question: what did you grow, feed or protect, and what can live independently after your intervention?
